get.description: Read the organisation selected by the authenticated credential. The result includes current permissions and identity fields, without a signing secret or balance. Send `Authorization: Bearer KEY_ID:KEY_SECRET` for server-side organisation API-key authority, or a verified personal dashboard Bearer session. The shared API key has Owner authority for these methods; keep it server-side. A personal session is checked against current membership and MFA. Owner, Admin and Member personal sessions may read their own context. The environment must have organisations enabled; otherwise these routes return 404. Personal invitation acceptance, leaving and ownership transfer are separate dashboard flows and are not API-key methods.

Send `Authorization: Bearer KEY_ID:KEY_SECRET` for server-side organisation API-key authority, or a verified personal dashboard Bearer session. A 202 response means the membership change committed but live disconnection remains unconfirmed. Neither status promises AI hand-back or ends an ongoing human call. get.description: Read current organisation activity, newest first. JSON pages contain up to 50 events. Owner and Admin personal sessions can read activity. Send `Authorization: Bearer KEY_ID:KEY_SECRET` for server-side organisation API-key authority, or a verified personal dashboard Bearer session. The shared API key has Owner authority for these methods; keep it server-side. A personal session is checked against current membership and MFA. Owner and Admin personal sessions are allowed. Members are refused. The environment must have organisations enabled; otherwise these routes return 404. Personal invitation acceptance, leaving and ownership transfer are separate dashboard flows and are not API-key methods. The from date must precede the exclusive day after to and cannot be in the future. Dates must be real YYYY-MM-DD dates. CSV uses 500-row chunks and streams the full matching result; 500 is not a total export limit. Permissions are checked for every chunk. An interrupted download is incomplete. CSV columns are When, Action and Result. The candidate kits support before and actor only; use direct HTTP for date filters or CSV. The older Node ActivityEvent type does not match this displayed response; use the fields documented here.
